- **Central nervous system effects:** Both alcohol and dextromethorphan (DXM)—a common active ingredient in Robitussin—affect the central nervous system. Together, they can cause extreme sedation, confusion, loss of balance, or slowed breathing. Liver damage: Processing both alcohol and certain cold medicine ingredients (especially acetaminophen in multi-symptom formulas) puts extra stress on your liver. Hidden alcohol in syrups: Some liquid cough and cold products already contain alcohol, which adds to your total intake. High-dose dangers: Taking large amounts of DXM with alcohol raises the risk of hallucinations, dissociation, rapid heartbeat, blood pressure spikes, overdose, or death.
